meta_description:
2,895 likes, 40 comments - kayla_itsines on October 23, 2026: "How you do anything… is how you do everything.

Social media is a highlight reel. You see someone's "overnight" success and forget there were years of quiet, unglamorous days behind it that nobody posted.

People see Sweat now but what they didn't see were, years of backyard PT sessions, the early mornings, the burnout and days it didn’t feel worth it…

So when your own progress feels slow and repetitive, that doesn't mean it isn't working. That IS the work.

And honestly, that's what makes it so fulfilling when you get there... because you know exactly what it took 🤍".
